cards.mood: The piece opens with an energetic, driving instrumental introduction that immediately establishes a lively and rustic atmosphere.
cards.palette: A bright, percussive banjo playing rapid, rolling arpeggios serves as the primary melodic and rhythmic driver, present from the Intro through to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Dusty boots dancing on the wooden floor
Swingin' shadows near the heavy barn door
Fiddle strings humming a sweet, steady tune
Under the light of a big harvest moon
[Pre-Chorus]
Pass the jar and pour a glass
Watch the golden moments slowly pass
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is wide and the grass is deep
Promises of old are the secrets we keep
With a heart of gold and a spirit free
Living out the life of our own destiny
[Verse]
The rolling hills stretch out so wide
With every turn, there's a beauty to find
Rolling wheels spinning on a gravel track
Moving forward never looking back
[Pre-Chorus]
The wind is whispering through the pines
Tracing out the map of our designs
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is wide and the grass is deep
Promises of old are the secrets we keep
With a heart of gold and a spirit free
Living out the life of our own destiny
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The sun sets low in a painted sky
While the stars begin to multiply
[Chorus]
Oh, the land is wide and the grass is deep
Promises of old are the secrets we keep
With a heart of gold and a spirit free
Living out the life of our own destiny
[Outro]
